ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: A student set up a laboratory experiment to study the behavior of earthworms. She prepared a 1-square-meter large tray, filled it with soil, and divided it into four quadrants, with different conditions set in each quadrant. She placed 20 earthworms in the tray, 5 in each quadrant. Based on this information, what is this laboratory setup called?

This indicates that the same tray/experimental area provides different environmental conditions for organisms to choose from. The question text states that the student used a 1-square-meter tray filled with soil to study earthworm behavior, divided the tray into four quadrants, with different conditions in each quadrant, and placed the same number of earthworms in each quadrant. An experimental apparatus with multiple compartments, different conditions, and used to observe animal preferences or behavioral choices is called a choice chamber.
